# Floating-base two-link articulation

Multi-prim test composition: a two-link reduced-coordinate articulation. /World/Base and /World/Link are Cube rigid bodies one unit apart joined by /World/Hinge, a PhysicsRevoluteJoint with body0 the parent (Base) so no sign flip applies to drive and state. PhysicsArticulationRootAPI and PhysxArticulationAPI sit on /World/Base itself; with no joint to world the articulation floats (no eFIX_BASE) and Base is the root link. Base is verified for its body and articulation columns. The hinge is verified through the articulation joint (PhysxJointAPI, PhysxJointAxisAPI, PhysicsJointStateAPI, PhysxDrivePerformanceEnvelopeAPI columns); its standalone PxJoint columns are unobservable here (NaN on both sides). Owns no columns and generates no helper.

- **Form:** multi-prim; no helper, the contract test builds each prim with `PrimBatch`.
